spagyric.definition:
a. Alt. of Spagyrical
n. A spagyrist.

spagyric medicine.translation: [医] 化学, 炼金术医学医学(指帕腊塞耳萨斯氏的医学体系)

spagyrist.definition:
n. A chemist, esp. one devoted to alchemistic pursuits.
n. One of a sect which arose in the days of alchemy, who
   sought to discover remedies for disease by chemical means. The
   spagyrists historically preceded the iatrochemists.
